ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts being made to combat it.
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are lawmakers and law enforcement working to combat it?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased oversight and accountability.
